Help when you need it

Neighbourhood Support.

Account issue, notification problem, weird app behaviour or a safety concern? Send us what happened and we’ll help you get it sorted.

Contact support

Email neighbourhood@nitratehub.xyz. If it’s a technical issue, include your device model, iOS version and app version if you can.

🔐

Account help

Sign-in, passkeys, password resets, profiles or account deletion.

🔔

Notifications

Missing alerts, notification permissions or unexpected notifications.

🛠️

Technical issues

Crashes, loading problems, display bugs or features not working correctly.

🛡️

Safety concerns

Misuse, harassment, concerning content or another community issue.

Before you email

  • Check that you’re using the latest version of Neighbourhood.
  • Close and reopen the app, then try the action again.
  • For notification issues, check Neighbourhood under iPhone Settings → Notifications.
  • Never send us your password, verification code or account security codes.

Account and data requests

To request access, correction or deletion of your account information, email us from the address linked to your account with the subject “Privacy Request”. We may need to verify that the account belongs to you before completing the request.

Emergency help

Neighbourhood is not an emergency service. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 000 in Australia or the emergency number for your location. Do not wait for a response from Neighbourhood support.

Response times

We aim to respond as soon as possible. Sending one email per issue helps keep everything together.
